ROSTER: This page gives you a detailed analysis of your team and your player's abilities; it shows you each player's stat ratings, allowing you to sort by each stat and clicking on a row of data gives you more information about a player; this information includes their height, weight and even potential rating. This page also shows your team's strengths and weaknesses compared to the rest of the league. However, depending on your play style, a stated weakness may not be an actual weakness.
TRADES: This page is where player and team negotiation occurs, including information such as player's salaries and contract lengths, allowing you to offer contract extensions to whom you please. Additionally, you can also sign free-agents from this page given you have the roster space.
STANDINGS: This page gives you a detailed breakdown of the league's team. It shows the league standings, along with tracked information such as total points allowed, field goal percentage and more. Projections of what the league could look like at the end of the season are given, updated after each game. Finally, it lists potential rivals for you to aim to beat. Clicking on a row of data brings a popup, giving a breakdown of a teams average stat ratings and other information such as cap space and their best player.
PLAYERS: This page provides information on every single player in the league. It includes information such as points per game, field goal percentage etc., allowing you to sort by any piece of information. It also gives projections of who the front-runners for the MVP, DPOY, ROTY and all-star awards/honours as well as tracking league records such as most points in a single game. Clicking on a row of data brings up a popup, showing a player's height, weight and potential rating etc.
SETTINGS: This page allows you to change your team name and state (once per season each) and provides descriptions like this on several aspects of the game.
